name: Priority Household (PHH) Ration Card Entitlement
description: National Food Security Act entitlement providing subsidized and free staple foodgrains (rice, wheat, coarse grains) to identified priority low-income families.
geographical_coverage: Pan-India (Administered via State Food & Civil Supplies departments, including Karnataka Ahara).
eligible_groups: Identified low-income and economically vulnerable households meeting state inclusion criteria
Families without permanent government salaried members or large agricultural land holdings
eligibility_criteria: Karnataka criteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,20,000; family must not own a four-wheeler (except commercial livelihood vehicle), agricultural land beyond ceiling, or have domestic electricity consumption exceeding 150 units/month.
benefits_or_service: 5 kg of foodgrains (rice/wheat) per family member per month completely free of cost at authorized Fair Price Shops under PMGKAY.
required_documents: Aadhaar Cards of all family members with biometric verification
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (Tahsildar / Nada Kacheri RD number)
Proof of residence (electricity bill / water bill / gas connection receipt)
Passport size photographs of the head of the family
application_steps: Step 1: Check eligibility against state exclusion criteria (annual income under ₹1.2L, no four-wheeler).
Step 2: Apply online via the state food portal (ahara.kar.nic.in in Karnataka) or through Grama One / Bangalore One / Seva Sindhu centres.
Step 3: Food Inspector conducts field verification of residential and socioeconomic credentials.
Step 4: Once sanctioned, biometric E-KYC is completed and Priority Household ration card is printed.
Step 5: Lift monthly free foodgrains at the allotted local Fair Price Shop using Aadhaar e-PoS authentication.

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) - Poorest of the Poor Entitlement
description: Specialized food security protection ensuring that the poorest and most destitute households receive a guaranteed fixed monthly basket of essential foodgrains.
eligible_groups: Landless agricultural labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans, and slum dwellers
Destitute widows, terminally ill persons, disabled persons, and persons aged 60+ with no societal or familial support
Tribal households in remote areas with extreme poverty
eligibility_criteria: Identified by Gram Sabha / Urban Local Bodies as falling in the poorest tier of Below Poverty Line households with no assured regular income.
benefits_or_service: 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month completely free of charge at Fair Price Shops.
required_documents: Aadhaar Cards of household members
Destitute / BPL verification certificate from local revenue authority / Gram Panchayat
Age / Disability proof or Widow pension certificate if claiming vulnerability category
Current residence certificate
application_steps: Step 1: Identification conducted through local Gram Sabha / Ward Committee survey.
Step 2: Submit AAY recommendation dossier to the Taluk Tahsildar / Food Shirastedar.
Step 3: Verification of indigent socioeconomic status by Taluk Food Inspector.
Step 4: Issue of distinctive Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration card.
Step 5: Draw 35 kg of free foodgrains monthly from the designated Fair Price Shop.

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) - Ration Portability
description: Interstate and intrastate digital portability enabling migrant workers and their families to lift subsidised or free foodgrains from any Fair Price Shop across India using their existing ration card.
geographical_coverage: Pan-India (Nationwide portability active across all 36 States and Union Territories).
eligible_groups: All active NFSA ration cardholders (PHH and AAY beneficiaries)
Migrant workers, laborers, construction workers, and families living away from their home district/state
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiary must hold an active NFSA ration card with Aadhaar seeded for at least one family member; treating Fair Price Shop must have an operational electronic Point of Sale (e-PoS) device.
benefits_or_service: Full or partial monthly foodgrain quota can be lifted at any FPS across India. Allows split-entitlements where migrant worker draws their share in another state while family draws the rest in their home village.
required_documents: Existing active Ration Card (number or physical card)
Aadhaar Card of the family member lifting foodgrains (mandatory for e-PoS biometric authentication)
application_steps: Step 1: No new registration or application is required. Portability is automatic for all seeded ration cards.
Step 2: Visit any nearby Fair Price Shop in your current town or state (locate using Mera Ration app).
Step 3: Provide your home state ration card number or Aadhaar number to the FPS dealer.
Step 4: Complete biometric fingerprint or IRIS authentication on the e-PoS device.
Step 5: Collect your monthly entitlement of foodgrains as recorded in the central IMPDS database.

name: Karnataka Ahara - Application for New Ration Card (BPL / APL)
description: Online government service provided by Karnataka Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department for issuing new Priority (BPL) or Non-Priority (APL) ration cards.
eligible_groups: Karnataka resident families who do not currently possess an active ration card in any state
Newly married couples establishing an independent household in Karnataka
eligibility_criteria: For BPL: Annual family income under ₹1,20,000; no 4-wheeler; power consumption under 150 units/month. For APL: Any Karnataka resident family regardless of income, subject to valid Aadhaar authentication.
benefits_or_service: Issuance of computerized electronic ration card (e-Ration Card) recognized for foodgrains distribution, healthcare scheme identification (Arogya Karnataka), and official government identity.
required_documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members to be enrolled
Income & Caste Certificate with 15-digit RD Number (Revenue Dept) for BPL applicants
Proof of Karnataka residence (Electricity bill / Rental agreement / Tax receipt)
Surrender / Deletion certificate if previously included in parents' ration card
application_steps: Step 1: Check that family members' Aadhaar details are updated with active mobile numbers for OTP verification.
Step 2: Visit ahara.kar.nic.in -> 'E-Services' -> 'New Ration Card' (service is also accessible at Bangalore One / Grama One / Seva Sindhu centres).
Step 3: Select Card Type (Priority BPL or Non-Priority APL).
Step 4: Authenticate family head and all members via Aadhaar OTP.
Step 5: Enter Revenue Department RD certificate number for automated income verification.
Step 6: Select your neighborhood Fair Price Shop and submit; download the e-Ration card acknowledgment slip.

name: Karnataka Ahara - Ration Card Correction & Member Modification
description: Public service to add new family members (children, new spouse), delete members (due to marriage or demise), correct spelling of names, change residential address, or transfer Fair Price Shop.
eligible_groups: Existing active Karnataka ration cardholders needing demographic or family member updates
eligibility_criteria: Must possess a valid active Karnataka ration card number; new members must possess Aadhaar cards.
benefits_or_service: Maintains accurate family member count for monthly foodgrain quota and ensures seamless linkage with welfare and scholarship portals.
required_documents: Existing Ration Card
For addition: Child's Birth Certificate and Aadhaar Card (or marriage certificate for spouse)
For deletion: Death Certificate (in case of demise) or Marriage Certificate / Transfer request
For address change: New residential electricity bill / address proof
application_steps: Step 1: Visit ahara.kar.nic.in -> 'E-Services' -> 'E-Ration Card Modification' or visit a nearby Bangalore One / Grama One centre.
Step 2: Enter your Ration Card number and authenticate the family head via Aadhaar OTP.
Step 3: Select the required service: 'Add Member', 'Delete Member', or 'Address Change'.
Step 4: Enter details and upload necessary verification certificates (e.g. Birth certificate for new child).
Step 5: Food Inspector reviews the application digitally.
Step 6: Download the updated e-Ration Card with modified member roster.

name: Karnataka Anna Bhagya Scheme (Food & Cash DBT Entitlement)
description: Flagship Karnataka state food security guarantee providing 5 kg free rice from the central pool plus direct monthly cash benefit transfer (DBT) at ₹34 per kg for an additional 5 kg of rice per beneficiary.
eligible_groups: Holders of valid Karnataka BPL (Priority Household - PHH) ration cards
Holders of valid Karnataka Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration cards
eligibility_criteria: Active Karnataka BPL/AAY ration card; the head of the family's bank account must be actively linked and seeded with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (National Payments Corporation of India - NPCI mapping).
benefits_or_service: 5 kg free rice per person per month distributed at Fair Price Shops PLUS ₹170 cash per person per month (equivalent to 5 kg @ ₹34/kg) credited directly to the woman head of household's bank account.
required_documents: Active Karnataka BPL / AAY Ration Card
Aadhaar Card of the woman head of the family
Bank Passbook showing NPCI-Aadhaar seeding status
application_steps: Step 1: Automatic entitlement for all active Karnataka BPL and AAY ration cardholders — no separate application is needed.
Step 2: Ensure the head of the family's bank account is linked to Aadhaar by visiting their bank branch or checking on the NPCI portal.
Step 3: Track monthly DBT credit status on ahara.kar.nic.in under 'E-Services' -> 'DBT Status' by entering the Ration Card number.
Step 4: Receive monthly SMS alerts on funds credited to your bank account.

name: Karnataka Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop) & Taluk Office Locator
description: Public search tool enabling residents to identify their assigned Fair Price Shop (FPS), authorized dealer name, shop address, contact details, and taluk food supply office.
geographical_coverage: Karnataka State (Covers all 31 districts and taluks including Bengaluru Urban).
eligible_groups: All ration cardholders and general public seeking their designated ration shop or grievance officer
eligibility_criteria: Open public service; requires district, taluk, and ward/village selection or active ration card number.
benefits_or_service: Displays dealer license name, shop registration number, exact street location, attached beneficiaries count, and contact phone numbers.
required_documents: Ration Card Number (optional, for direct lookup) or residential locality details
application_steps: Step 1: Open ahara.kar.nic.in -> 'E-Services' -> 'Fair Price Shop Details'.
Step 2: Select your District (e.g., Bengaluru Urban), Taluk (e.g., Bengaluru South), and Ward/Area.
Step 3: View the list of authorized Fair Price Shops with dealer names and addresses.
Step 4: Visit the allotted shop with your ration card during working hours (typically 8 AM - 12 PM and 4 PM - 8 PM).

name: Ration Card Application & Eligibility Status Tracking
description: Real-time verification service allowing applicants to check the progress of new ration card applications, status of Food Inspector field inspections, and card validity.
eligible_groups: Any citizen who has submitted a new ration card application or member modification request in Karnataka
eligibility_criteria: Requires valid acknowledgment number / application number generated during Seva Sindhu or Ahara submission.
benefits_or_service: Transparent tracking of application stage: Pending verification, Inspector approved, Card printed, or Dispatched to Bangalore One / Grama One centre.
required_documents: Application Acknowledgment Number (e.g., RC2026...)
Registered Mobile Number for OTP confirmation
application_steps: Step 1: Visit ahara.kar.nic.in -> 'E-Services' -> 'E-Status' -> 'Status of New/Modified Ration Card'.
Step 2: Choose verification method: 'With Acknowledgment Number' or 'Without Acknowledgment Number (via Aadhaar)'.
Step 3: Enter the required details and captcha.
Step 4: View the real-time stage of the file, officer remarks, and estimated completion date.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Central government scheme providing 100% free foodgrains to approximately 81.35 crore NFSA beneficiaries (Priority Households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana) nationwide for five years from 2024 to 2028.
eligible_groups: All active NFSA Priority Household (PHH) ration cardholders
All active Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cardholders
eligibility_criteria: Valid NFSA ration card with Aadhaar seeding. Completely free distribution — no payment of central issue prices (₹3/kg rice, ₹2/kg wheat) is required.
benefits_or_service: 100% free foodgrains: 5 kg per person per month for PHH cards, and 35 kg per family per month for AAY cards.
required_documents: Active NFSA Ration Card
Aadhaar Card for biometric authentication on e-PoS device
application_steps: Step 1: Automatic benefit for existing NFSA cardholders; no separate registration is needed.
Step 2: Visit your assigned Fair Price Shop during distribution dates.
Step 3: Authenticate identity on the e-PoS device using fingerprint or iris scan.
Step 4: Collect free foodgrains and verify zero amount is printed on the electronic receipt.

name: Mera Ration Mobile App & National Grievance Redressal
description: Official mobile app developed by the Department of Food & Public Distribution (NIC) to empower NFSA beneficiaries to view entitlements, locate nearby ration shops, check ONORC status, and register grievances.
geographical_coverage: Pan-India (Available in 14 languages including Kannada, Hindi, and English).
eligible_groups: All NFSA ration cardholders, particularly migrant workers and low-income families
eligibility_criteria: Active ration card number or Aadhaar number of any registered family member.
benefits_or_service: Interactive GPS map to find nearest Fair Price Shop, view monthly entitlement quota, check recent 6-month ration transactions, verify Aadhaar seeding, and submit grievances.
required_documents: Ration Card Number or Aadhaar Number
application_steps: Step 1: Download 'Mera Ration' official app from Google Play Store (developed by National Informatics Centre - NIC).
Step 2: Enter your 12-digit Ration Card number or Aadhaar number to view your entitlement profile.
Step 3: Click 'Nearby Ration Shops' to see exact distance and direction to authorized FPS in your current GPS vicinity.
Step 4: Use 'Grievance' tab or dial 1967 if any shop dealer overcharges, refuses foodgrains, or operates irregularly.
